ios.desc:
Secure Encrypted Text Editor for Confidential Text Handling

Experience an encrypted, plain-text editor designed for secure, private text handling.

Markdown support

Unique File Extension Files are saved with a unique .etxt extension, which stands for Encrypted Text, ensuring enhanced protection for sensitive information.
Download Free on macOS Our macOS version is now available for free! Download directly from binhua.org/untitled.
